scope: Named implementations only; no general impossibility claim

proposals.name: Only second-pass depths 2--4, fully packed six descendant fields
proposals.omitted: All new layout, address, and metadata preparation costs
proposals.pointer_note: The second-pass p3 has no later consumer and can vanish.

proposals.name: Both passes of depths 2--4, retaining the existing p5 formula
proposals.omitted: All new layout, address, and metadata preparation costs
proposals.pointer_note: First-pass p5 = p3 + signed_b4 * V[b3] still requires p3, including its MAD and two selector FLOWs.  Moving p3 computation to round5 does not remove its cost.

proposals.name: Depths 7--9 triples, direct depth10 pointer, fully packed descendants
proposals.omitted: New address constants, global in-place preparation hazards, and scheduling costs
proposals.setup: Optimistically reuses the original first511 source loads; adds128 vloads for groups of four raw depth9 grandchildren. The128 new eight-word record stores replace64 old image stores.
proposals.pointer_note: p7 stride8 can encode the depth7 path for direct leaf addressing.  Selecting its three-bit depth10 digit uses seven FLOWs in this implementation.
